name: Burning
description: Applies thermal damage over time, prevents health regeneration, and triggers panic/flailing reactions on affected targets.

name: Electrocuted
description: Deals electrical shock damage over time, interrupts actions, and temporarily disables cyberware functionality.

name: Poisoned
description: Inflicts chemical damage over time and slows movement and attack speed.

name: Bleeding
description: Causes physical hemorrhage damage over time and reduces stamina recovery.

name: Cyberware Malfunction
description: Jams target cyberware implants, shutting down active abilities and slowing movement.

name: Blind
description: Blinds visual optics sensors, drastically reducing target detection range and combat accuracy.

name: Stun
description: Stuns the target, leaving them completely incapacitated and unable to move or attack for a brief duration.

name: EMP Disruption
description: Disables cyberware, interrupts active hacks, and deals heavy damage to automated drones and mechs.

name: Memory Wipe
description: Forces enemies out of combat state and clears their current alert and detection meter.

name: Knockdown
description: Knocks the target off their feet onto the ground, requiring time to recover and stand up.

name: Defeated
description: Sets the target into an unconscious or downed non-lethal state.

name: Quadra Turbo-R V-Tech
description: Iconic high-performance muscle sports car favored by street mercenaries in Night City.

name: Mizutani Shion "Coyote"
description: Nomad-modified sports coupe reinforced for off-road Badlands driving with reinforced suspension.

name: Militech Hellhound
description: Heavy combat-armored military APC vehicle equipped with mounted dual machine guns and missile launchers.

name: Rayfield Caliburn
description: Ultra-luxury aerodynamic hypercar, the fastest street-legal production vehicle in Night City.

name: Thorton Colby "Little Mule"
description: Durable workhorse pickup truck commonly modified by Nomads for cargo hauling and rough terrain.

name: Porsche 911 Turbo (930)
description: Johnny Silverhand's classic 1977 sports coupe, customized with Samurai liveries.

name: Herrera Outlaw GTS
description: Sleek executive luxury limousine blending top-tier speed with armor plating.

name: Yaiba Kusanagi CT-3X
description: Aerodynamic sport motorcycle built for extreme speeds, inspired by classic anime aesthetics.

name: ARCH Nazare
description: Custom cruiser motorcycle built by ARCH Motorcycle, renowned for raw torque and distinct exhaust sound.

name: Malorian Arms 3516 (Johnny's Pistol)
description: Custom heavy power pistol designed specifically for Johnny Silverhand, featuring explosive punch and flamethrower melee.

name: Katana (Arasaka Standard)
description: Standard high-frequency blade designed for rapid strikes, parrying, and high crit damage.

name: Techtronika RT-46 Omaha
description: Tech pistol firing a 3-round burst that can be charged to penetrate cover and heavy armor.

name: Tsunami Nekomata
description: Tech sniper rifle firing high-velocity rail projectiles capable of shooting through walls and obstacles.

name: Budget Arms Carnage
description: Heavy pump-action power shotgun delivering devastating close-range kinetic force.

name: Militech M-10AF Lexington
description: Reliable full-auto power handgun widely deployed across Night City security forces.

name: Nokota D5 Copperhead
description: Workhorse power assault rifle offering balanced recoil, rate of fire, and mid-range precision.

name: Mantis Blades
description: Lethal arm cyberware blades extending from forearms for swift dismemberment and leaping attacks.

name: Suicide (Tier 4 / Iconic)
description: Ultimate quickhack forcing the target to turn their weapon on themselves.

name: Overheat (Tier 4 / Iconic)
description: Combat quickhack overheating the target's neural circuitry to apply continuous thermal damage.

name: Cyberware Malfunction (Tier 4 / Iconic)
description: Covert quickhack disabling target cyberware and detonating cyberware upon stacking multiple times.

name: System Collapse (Tier 4 / Iconic)
description: Ultimate covert quickhack quietly knocking out target's consciousness without raising alarms.

name: Short Circuit (Tier 4 / Iconic)
description: Combat quickhack sending high-voltage electrical charge to fry electronic systems and organic nerves.

name: Contagion (Tier 4 / Iconic)
description: Stealth quickhack spreading chemical poison virus between closely clustered targets.

name: Sit in Chair
description: Workspot node animation sequence for sitting comfortably in standard chairs, dining stools, or office seats.

name: Lean Against Wall
description: Workspot node animation sequence for leaning back against vertical walls or barriers.

name: Smoke Cigarette
description: Workspot node animation sequence for lighting, puffing, and holding a cigarette.

name: Drink at Bar
description: Workspot node animation sequence for holding drink glasses, taking sips, and idling at a bar counter.

name: Dance in Club
description: Workspot node animation sequence for rhythmic club dancing and crowd party gestures.

name: Type on Computer
description: Workspot node animation sequence for operating terminals, typing on keyboards, and monitoring screens.

name: Basic Trench Coat
description: Standard weather-resistant long coat providing wind and rain protection with inner pockets.

name: Basic Cargo Pants
description: Durable cotton-kevlar utility pants equipped with multiple reinforced gear pouches.

name: Basic High-Top Sneakers
description: Streetwear rubber-soled high-top sneakers popular across Night City districts.

name: Basic Crewneck T-Shirt
description: Simple cotton crewneck tee worn casually across all social classes.

name: Tactical Armored Vest
description: Ballistic armor vest offering torso protection against pistol and intermediate rifle fire.
